title: Server recovery operation parameters
description: Parameters for a durable server recovery operation. This operation attempts to bring a failed/degraded server back to healthy state without destroying data or instance.

recovery_intent.description: The recovery action to perform. One of: revalidate, restart, restore, replace.

target_instance_ref.description: Optional specific instance reference to target. If omitted, use existing or select from hosting adapter.

target_generation_id.description: Target data generation ID for restore operations. If omitted, use current generation.

backup_ref.description: Reference to a specific backup for restore operations. Required when target_generation_id is provided.

recovery_budget.description: Time budget for recovery operation before it times out or transitions to failed.

max_duration.description: Maximum duration in seconds. Zero means no timeout.

retry_count.description: Number of retry attempts before giving up on automatic recovery.

lock_scope.description: Lock scope for this operation. Prevents concurrent conflicting operations.

force_recovery.description: When true, bypasses some safety checks. Requires explicit authorization.

authorization_ref.description: Reference to an authorization token or approval for force recovery operations.
